decision.purpose: Development only; never automatic promotion or actuation
decision.candidate_screen: Both primary metrics must improve in all three paired seeds; selected geometry pass count must not fall, speed MAE must not rise more than 5% in any pair
decision.test_policy: Never evaluate or select on new held-out Town04 test during this campaign
decision.remaining: Independent test, scenario coverage, 10Hz shadow and closed-loop safety gates remain mandatory
